title: Art-Integrated GenAI Literacy for Music and Theater Educators
description: A fully online, self-paced course that builds generative AI (GenAI) literacy through hands-on music and theater projects. Across two modules and eight lessons you will compose, produce, script, animate, and choreograph with GenAI tools while developing seven competencies: computational thinking, prompt engineering, problem solving, creativity and innovation, AI feedback evaluation, AI ethics literacy, and collaboration. Every lesson ends with a shareable digital artifact and a short written rationale.
audience: Pre-service and in-service music and theater teachers; arts educators new to generative AI.
duration: About 12 to 16 hours total. Each lesson takes 60 to 90 minutes. Self-paced.
instructor: Idowu David Awoyemi, The University of Alabama
